snippet.title: Do Not Press The Button (Or You'll Delete The Multiverse) - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Do Not Press The Button (Or You'll Delete The Multiverse) trailer for this first-person exploration game where you are allowed to do anything except press that BIG RED BUTTON. Enjoy different activities, look for secret areas and find new ways to annoy The Developer. The game features comedic narration inspired by games such as The Stanley Parable, Portal 2, and others. Do Not Press The Button (Or You'll Delete The Multiverse) will be available on PC via Steam on April 16, 2025.
